'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s kill at least 82 people across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 30 in [[Gaza City]], hours after the announcement of a [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|ceasefire agreement]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/16/israeli-attacks-kill-30-palestinians-in-gaza-after-ceasefire-deal-announced (Al Jazeera)]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]] 
***The [[Israel]]i and [[Hamas]] negotiating teams sign the hostage release and ceasefire deal in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israel-and-hamas-sign-hostage-ceasefire-deal-after-mediators-iron-out-final-kinks/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]], [[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***The [[Puntland Security Force]] claims to have captured a training facility used by [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIL]] militants, with over forty ISIL fighters killed following heavy fighting.  [https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia/105485/puntland-forces-record-major-victories-against-isis-in-somalia (''The Eastleigh Voice'')] 
***Thousands of families are displaced as the military campaign intensifies, forcing locals to flee their homes in [[Bari, Somalia|Bari region]] of [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-urging-international-community-while-forces-crack-down-toward-isis-discover-foreign-passports-and-bank-cards/ (Idil News)] [https://hornobserver.com/articles/3126/Puntland-Appeals-for-Urgent-Aid-Amid-Military-Operations-Against-ISIS (''Horn Observer'')]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The leader of the [[Houthis]] [[Abdul-Malik al-Houthi]] announces that the group will monitor the implementation of the [[Three-phase Israel–Hamas war ceasefire proposal|Israel–Hamas ceasefire agreement]] and continue its attacks on vessels and on [[Israel]] if the ceasefire is breached. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20250116-yemens-houthis-to-continue-attacks-if-gaza-ceasefire-breached/ (''Middle East Monitor'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. Treasury Department]] sanctions the head of the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] [[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] for "destabilizing [[Sudan]] and undermining the goal of a democratic transition" to a civilian-led government. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn8x5nkj8pyo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 California wildfires]]
**[[January 2025 Southern California wildfires]]
***It is reported that the [[Eaton Fire]], which has burned over 14,000 acres and has killed 17 people, is 65% contained. [https://www.cbsnews.com/losangeles/news/eaton-fire-containment-altadena-strong-winds/ (CBS News)]
*[[Stilfontein mine deaths]]
**The bodies of nine [[illegal mining|illegal miners]] trapped inside a [[gold mine]] in [[Stilfontein]], [[South Africa]], are recovered by [[South African Police Service|police]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/standoff-in-south-africa-ends-with-87-miners-dead-and-anger-over-polices-smoke-them-out-tactics/ (CTV News)]
*A boat carrying migrants capsizes near [[Dakhla, Western Sahara]] on its way to Spain's [[Canary Islands]], killing at least 50 people including 44 Pakistanis. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-migrant-boat-capsize-morocco-29d58ccf4ffdcde2860bbbce948c7ff0 (AP News)]
*Two [[Demining|deminer]]s are killed in an explosion while attempting to remove a [[Cambodian Civil War]]-era [[anti-tank mine]] from a rice field in [[Oddar Meanchey province]], [[Cambodia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/landmine-cambodia-killed-cmac-khmer-rouge-c4468881e8805a3106c56f8a2e664d34 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Ukraine–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] [[List of international prime ministerial trips made by Keir Starmer|visits]] [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], to sign a 100-year agreement with Ukraine that will formalize [[UK|British]] economic and military support for Ukraine. [https://news.sky.com/story/sir-keir-starmer-to-sign-100-year-friendship-deal-with-ukraine-in-first-kyiv-visit-since-becoming-pm-13289508 (Sky News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgem31jekvo (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Taiwan]]
**[[Taiwan]] carries out its first execution in five years on a man who was convicted of the 2013 murder of his former girlfriend and her mother. [https://uk.news.yahoo.com/taiwan-carries-first-execution-five-003203347.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[Spišská Stará Ves school stabbing]]
**Two women are killed and a third is injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a school in [[Spišská Stará Ves]], [[Slovakia]]. The perpetrator is arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2kvz9d9rvo (BBC News)] [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/law-order/3227238-tragic-school-stabbing-in-slovakia-two-dead (Devdiscourse)]
*Two [[Homelessness|homeless people]] are killed and two others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] attack in [[Miami]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. A 30-year-old suspect is arrested. [https://www.nbcmiami.com/news/local/police-investigate-death-in-downtown-miami-detain-suspect-armed-with-stick/3517156/ (NBC News)]
*The [[Government of Cuba]] releases dissident and human rights activist [[José Daniel Ferrer]] from jail. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/cuba-releases-jailed-dissident-rights-activist-jose-daniel-ferrer-2025-01-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2021–present Bulgarian political crisis]]
**The [[Parliament of Bulgaria]] approves a [[Zhelyazkov Government|coalition government]] consisting of the [[GERB-SDS]], [[BSP – United Left]], and [[There is Such a People]] parties, with GERB's [[Rosen Zhelyazkov]] becoming [[Prime Minister of Bulgaria|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/01/16/bulgarian-parliament-approves-centre-right-coalition-government (Euronews)]
*[[2024 French political crisis]]
**The [[Bayrou government|government]] of [[Prime Minister of France|French Prime Minister]] [[François Bayrou]] survives a [[Motion of no confidence|no-confidence motion]] by the opposition [[New Popular Front]] electoral alliance. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/01/16/new-french-prime-minister-francois-bayrou-survives-no-confidence-vote (Euronews)]
*[[2025 Vanuatuan general election]]
**Citizens of [[Vanuatu]] vote for the 52 members of [[Parliament of Vanuatu|Parliament]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/539119/polling-underway-in-vanuatu (RNZ)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2025 in spaceflight]]
**[[Blue Origin]] launches its [[New Glenn]] rocket for the first time from [[Cape Canaveral Space Force Station]] in [[Florida]], [[United States]]. The rocket's [[Multistage rocket|second stage]], carrying a prototype [[Blue Ring]] spacecraft, successfully reaches a [[geocentric orbit]], but its [[Reusable launch vehicle|reusable]] first stage is lost during landing. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/16/science/new-glenn-launch-blue-origin/index.html (CNN)]
**The twin satellites SDX01 and SDX02 of the [[SpaDeX]] mission, launched in December by the [[Indian Space Research Organisation]], successfully conduct [[India]]'s first [[Docking and berthing of spacecraft|spacecraft docking]], with India becoming the fourth country to successfully dock a spacecraft after the [[United States]], [[Russia]], and [[China]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8j89k02py0o (BBC News)]
**[[SpaceX]] launches its [[Starship flight test 7|seventh test flight]] of the [[SpaceX Starship|Starship launch vehicle]], with an improved [[SpaceX Starship (spacecraft)|second stage]], at [[SpaceX Starbase|Starbase]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]]. The [[SpaceX Super Heavy|first stage]] is successfully caught by the launch tower but the second stage breaks up shortly before engine shutdown. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/01/16/spacex-launch-starship-flight-seven-starlink-satellite-test.html (CNBC)]
*[[Nintendo]] officially reveals the [[Nintendo Switch 2]] [[video game console]], the successor to the [[Nintendo Switch]]. [https://www.nintendo.com/us/whatsnew/nintendo-switch-2-to-be-released-in-2025/ (Nintendo)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 in sumo]]
**Shortly after withdrawing from the January 2025 [[Honbasho|Grand Sumo Tournament]] due to injuries, the 73rd ''[[yokozuna]]'' [[Terunofuji Haruo]] announces his retirement. If no other wrestler is promoted this tournament, his retirement leaves [[sumo]] without a ''yokozuna'' for the first time since [[1993 in sumo|1993]]. Terunofuji also announced his intention to remain in the [[Japan Sumo Association]] as an ''[[toshiyori|oyakata]]''. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2025/01/14bd63c63a6b-sumo-lone-yokozuna-terunofuji-pulls-out-of-new-year-meet.html (''Kyodo News'')] [https://www.nikkansports.com/battle/sumo/news/202501160000520.html (''Nikkan Sports'')]
